data.name: Obscurinth
data.detailed_description:
Enter the darkest labyrinth ever discovered.

A forgotten place buried for thousands of years, where the stones seem to breathe, statues watch your every step, and every corridor may hide a secret capable of changing your entire adventure.

You play as Joy, a strange yet fearless little creature lost within a vast living labyrinth. Your objective seems simple: find the exit.

But the deeper you venture...

...the more you realize that escaping the labyrinth may not be its greatest mystery.

The real mystery is discovering why it exists.

Every expedition tells a different story

Obscurinth is far more than a maze game.

It is a vast world built around exploration, where every turn may reveal a hidden passage, a forgotten chamber, an ancient statue, a mysterious entity, or a treasure that only the most curious explorers will ever find.

Every path matters.

Every discovery is rewarding.

Grow stronger with every adventure

Every expedition leaves a permanent mark on your journey.

Find permanent keys that unlock shortcuts forever.

Increase your movement speed.

Improve your score multiplier.

Unlock new ways to explore the labyrinth more efficiently.

Even after starting a new adventure, your greatest discoveries remain with you.

Your progress never truly disappears.

Create your own survival strategy

Place lanterns wherever you need them to illuminate dangerous passages and mark your route through the darkness.

Deploy portable save braziers deep inside the labyrinth to secure your progress before venturing even farther.

Over time, every player develops their own unique way of exploring, surviving, and mastering the maze.

Hundreds of secrets await discovery

The labyrinth is filled with mysteries.

Forgotten statues.

Rare diamonds.

Ancient wells.

Hidden relics.

Forbidden chambers.

Mysterious creatures.

Lost witch treasures.

Every discovery expands your Grimoire and slowly reveals the history of a civilization that vanished thousands of years ago.

Some pages will remain unknown until you uncover their secrets yourself.

Face Obscurinth

Deep beneath the labyrinth lies Obscurinth, its ancient guardian.

A powerful creature trapped by an age-old curse.

Reaching it is already an achievement.

Defeating it will demand far more than courage.

Built for explorers... and speedrunners

Your first expedition will reward patience, curiosity, and careful observation.

Then, as you uncover more secrets, you'll learn to optimize every route and every decision.

The most dedicated players can challenge the global leaderboards and attempt to master a labyrinth that even its creator needed several hours to conquer.

A world that never reveals everything

Obscurinth combines exploration, puzzles, permanent progression, and dark fantasy in a mysterious world where every detail may matter.

Every statue tells a story.

Every location hides a mystery.

Every discovery raises new questions.

The deeper you explore...

...the more alive the labyrinth begins to feel.

And just when you believe you've uncovered every secret...

Obscurinth will finally begin to reveal its true nature.
